items.headline: Genuine question — does anyone actually think about what happens when someone sends a malicious goal to their agent?
items.summary: Not talking about jailbreaks or fancy attacks. Just someone typing something weird into your agent's input field. I run a small LangGraph workflow. Last week I got curious and typed something malicious as the input — basically asking the agent to ignore its instructions. It worked. Completely. The agent just... did what I asked. items.headline: No one seems to be talking about the incredible claude-sonnet-4-6 latency!
items.summary: Ignore everything else – the latency of claude-sonnet-4-6 is incredible! I benchmark and stress test every model immediately after it gets released, and I've literally not seen any model immediately after release have sub 1 second complete response times. It's currently even faster than the Haiku models (~1.8s vs <1s) https://glama.ai/gateway/models Need to collect more data, but it seems like this might be the best option for latency sensitive operations.    submitted by    /u/punkpe
